novelConfig.title: Novel Configuration
novelConfig.description: Define your novel's basic info and writing parameters

plotStructureTips.three_act: Three-Act: Classic "Setup→Confrontation→Resolution", suitable for most web novel types
plotStructureTips.heros_journey: Hero's Journey: 12 mythological stages, suitable for adventure/growth stories emphasizing inner transformation
plotStructureTips.save_the_cat: Beat Sheet: Hollywood 15-beat structure, most refined pacing, suitable for emotionally intense stories
plotStructureTips.kishotenketsu: Kishotenketsu: Traditional Chinese four-part structure, suitable for ancient/wuxia/xianxia genres
plotStructureTips.multi_thread: Multi-thread: Multiple storylines interweaving, suitable for ensemble casts or complex plots
plotStructureTips.freeform: Freeform: No specific framework, AI adapts to content, suitable for slice-of-life/light novels

narrativePOVTips.first_person: First Person: "I" perspective, strongest immersion, limited information
narrativePOVTips.third_limited: Third Person Limited: Follows protagonist, balances immersion and flexibility, most common
narrativePOVTips.third_omniscient: Third Person Omniscient: Can freely switch between characters' minds, suitable for ensemble narratives
narrativePOVTips.multi_pov: Multi-POV: Multiple characters take turns narrating, suitable for complex ensemble stories
